answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments with five LLMs on five benchmarks to validate the generalizability of MARKERGEN, covering cross-task (summarization, story generation, QA, heuristic generation), cross-scale (from 10+ to 1000+ words), cross-lingual (English and Chinese) and crossgranularity (precise and rough constraints) settings.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text (summaries, stories, answers, etc.) with controlled length

answer_2.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that under precise length constraints, MARKERGEN re-duces length errors by 12.57% compared to baselines (with an average absolute error of 5.57%) ... In range-based length constraints, MARKERGEN achieves a 99% acceptance rate...

answer_3.quote: To evaluate the text quality, we use GPT-4o mini ... we report point-wise quality scores evaluated by three different LLMs: GPT-4o, Gemini-2.0-Flash (thinking-exp), and GPT-4o-mini.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 200 pairwise comparisons and observed a strong Spearman's correlation coefficient of 0.8794 between GPT-4o-mini judgments and human annotations...
